meta.title: Fork the City — public proposals with history
meta.description: Create, compare, and review spatial proposals without losing their provenance.

hero.title: One real square. Proposals that keep their history.
hero.body: Start from a documented reference, create an alternative, and compare it with others before making a decision.

map.title: Plaza de la Constitución
map.aria: Schematic of the reference boundary and two overlapping hypothetical interventions
map.status: This view does not require the remote basemap. Local geometry and the feature list remain available.
map.interactiveReady: Interactive map ready. Use arrow keys to pan and plus or minus to zoom.

ledger.title: What we know and what we are imagining
ledger.referenceBody: The square boundary comes from the listed OpenStreetMap object. Coverage is partial: it does not confirm trees, stalls, or a pedestrian inventory.
ledger.scenarioBody: The canopy and market zone are examples created to evaluate alternatives. They do not describe existing works or a municipal proposal.

auth.title: Return to your proposal.
auth.body: Sign in to create private branches and publish revisions without losing their provenance.
auth.error: We could not verify those details. Check the email address and password.
auth.privacy: Your email is used for the session and never appears in public views.

branches.title: Open a line of work without changing the reference.
branches.body: Your branch starts with an immutable revision. Nobody else can see it until you explicitly publish a revision.
branches.nameHelp: Describe the goal in 100 characters or fewer.
branches.created: Private branch created. Its initial revision is saved.
branches.error: We could not create the branch. Check the details and try again.
branches.loadError: We could not load your private branches.
branches.empty: You do not have any branches yet. Create the first one to start editing.

editor.pickHint: With a mouse or finger, tap the preview to place the intervention at that point. The dashed outline shows where it will go before you add it. With a keyboard, type the coordinates in the form.
editor.picked: Position updated from the preview. Check the coordinates, then add the intervention.
editor.pickInForm: Tap the preview above to choose where it goes. You do not need to type coordinates.
editor.previewAria: Schematic preview with the square boundary and this branch's interventions
editor.empty: This branch has no interventions yet. Add the first one with the form.

coordinatesHelp.Point: One line with "longitude, latitude" in WGS84.
coordinatesHelp.LineString: One line per vertex; at least two.
coordinatesHelp.Polygon: One line per vertex; at least three. Do not repeat the first one: the polygon closes itself.

editor.messageHelp: Up to 100 characters. It is recorded with the revision.
editor.nothingToSave: There are no changes to save.
editor.saved: Revision saved. It is now the current version of your branch.
editor.staleHead: Another session saved this branch before you did. Your draft is still on this device.
editor.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again; your local draft is kept.
editor.notFound: This branch is no longer available.
editor.network: We could not connect. Your changes are still on this device; try again.
editor.genericError: We could not save the revision. Your changes are still on this device.
editor.outsideSite: An intervention lies outside the square boundary. Check its coordinates.

reasons.feature_outside_site: it lies outside the square boundary.
reasons.invalid_geometry: the geometry is not valid; for example, it crosses itself.
reasons.invalid_feature_properties: a value is outside the allowed range.
reasons.kind_not_supported: this type is not available in the pilot.
reasons.invalid_revision: the revision data is not valid.

fieldErrors.label: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
fieldErrors.number: Enter a number within the stated range.
fieldErrors.timeSlot: Enter a time slot of 1 to 40 characters.
fieldErrors.format: Use one line per vertex in the format "longitude, latitude".
fieldErrors.count: This geometry type needs more vertices.

editor.draftFound: There is a local draft saved on {date}.
editor.draftOlderBase: It was based on an earlier revision. Review the changes before saving them.
editor.draftRecovered: Draft recovered. Use Undo to return to the saved version.
editor.publishSummaryHelp: Explain in plain language what this revision proposes. Up to 1000 characters.
editor.publishConsent: I understand that the name, the summary, this revision's interventions, and my public alias will be published. My email and my private revisions are not published.
editor.published: Revision published. Its link will not change if you keep editing.
editor.publishNeedsContent: Save at least one intervention before publishing.
editor.publishError: We could not publish the revision. Check the name and the summary.
editor.publicationsEmpty: You have not published a revision yet.
editor.publishLabelRequired: Enter a public name of 1 to 100 characters.
editor.publishSummaryRequired: Enter a public summary of 1 to 1000 characters.
editor.publishConsentRequired: Confirm that you understand what will be published.
editor.publicationHiddenHead: This revision was published, but moderation hid it. Its public link is not available.
editor.profileRequired: Your account has no public alias, so it cannot publish. Tell the pilot team. Your saved revision is unchanged.
editor.forkedFrom: This branch was forked from a public publication.
editor.sourceUnavailable: This branch was forked from a publication that is no longer available.

publication.immutable: This published revision is fixed: later changes by its author do not modify it.
publication.hypothetical: Every intervention is hypothetical. None describes existing works or a municipal decision.
publication.previewAria: Schematic preview of the published proposal over the square boundary
publication.metaDescription: Hypothetical community proposal published on Fork the City.
publication.forkBody: Creates a private copy of this revision in your account. The original publication does not change and your copy stays hypothetical. If you are not signed in, we will ask you to sign in first.
publication.forkFailed: We could not fork the proposal. Try again.
publication.forkInvalidTitle: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters for your branch.
publication.unavailableBody: The link does not exist or the publication was withdrawn by moderation. Check the address or go back to the square.

merge.title: Merge a proposal into your branch
merge.intro: Bring the changes of the published proposal “{source}” into your branch “{target}”. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

ancestor.own_revision: Common ancestor: an earlier revision of your branch.
ancestor.private_revision: Common ancestor: someone else's private revision; its details are not shown.

merge.noConflicts: No conflicts: the changes merge without decisions.

conflictTypes.edit_edit: Both versions changed “{label}” in different ways.
conflictTypes.edit_delete: One version changed “{label}” and the other removed it.
conflictTypes.exclusive_overlap: “{first}” and “{second}” use the same surface: {area} m² in common (threshold {threshold} m²).

merge.redrawHelp: One line per vertex. The polygon closes itself. The shape is never adjusted automatically.
merge.redrawInvalid: Check the coordinates: use one line per vertex as “longitude, latitude”.
merge.stillBlocking: Still blocking: the new shape still overlaps.
merge.warningLine: Overlap that already existed in a single version ({area} m²). It does not block the merge.
merge.resultAria: Schematic preview of the merge result over the square boundary
merge.commitBlocked: Resolve every conflict and check your decisions before saving.
merge.tooManyFeatures: The result would have {count} interventions and the limit is 200. Remove some in your branch or in this merge.
merge.committed: Merge saved. The new revision has two parents: your previous revision and the proposal.
merge.invalidResolution: A decision is not valid. Review it and try again.
merge.staleHead: Your branch changed since this preview. Reload to see the current state.
merge.publicationUnavailable: The proposal is no longer available to merge.

errors.merge_incompatible: This proposal does not share the site and baseline of your branch.
errors.nothing_to_merge: Your branch already contains this proposal.
errors.already_merged: You already merged this proposal into your branch.
errors.ancestor_limit_exceeded: The history is too long to find a common ancestor.
errors.too_many_features: The result exceeds 200 interventions. Remove some to continue.
errors.generic: We could not merge. Try again.

merge.network: We could not connect. Your decisions stay on this page; try again.
merge.entryTitle: Merge into one of my branches
merge.entryBody: Preview how this proposal would look combined with one of your private branches.
merge.entryNoBranches: Create a private branch to merge proposals.
merge.mergedFrom: The current revision merges a published proposal.
merge.mergedSourceUnavailable: The current revision merges a proposal that is no longer available. The merged changes are kept.

compare.title: Proposal comparison
compare.hypothetical: Every intervention is hypothetical. None describes existing works or a municipal decision.
compare.illustrative: Illustrative budget: evaluation prices dated {date}, not supplier quotes.
compare.coverageNote: Shade covers only the inventoried elements; the square's survey is partial.
compare.mapAria: Schematic map of the changes between the two revisions over the square boundary
compare.noChanges: Both revisions have the same interventions.
compare.missingBody: Open a published proposal and use “Compare with the baseline”.
compare.notFoundTitle: We could not find one of the revisions
compare.notFoundBody: The link may be incomplete or the content was withdrawn by moderation.
compare.incompatibleBody: The two revisions do not share the same site and baseline.
compare.errorBody: We could not compare. Try again.

features.title: Alternative available without a map
features.shadeDetail: 4.5 m modelled height · no implementation evidence
features.warning: The two geometries overlap. A merge will need to keep, remove, or redraw one of them.

community.title: Community
community.scopeNotice: Comments are plain text, public, and shown with your alias. Support is a signal of interest: it does not approve, reject, or decide anything.
community.supportZero: Nobody has supported this proposal yet.
community.signInPrompt: Sign in to comment, support, or report.
community.commentHelp: Plain text, up to 1000 characters. Do not include other people's personal data.
community.reportHelp: Only the site's moderators see your report. The reported person does not learn who reported.

status.report_duplicate: You already had an open report about this.

errors.invalid_comment: The comment must be between 1 and 1000 characters of plain text.
errors.invalid_report: Check the reason and the details of the report.
errors.invalid_anchor: The chosen intervention does not belong to this proposal.
errors.rate_limited: You did many actions in a row. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.not_found: This content is no longer available.
errors.generic: We could not complete the action. Try again.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.noRole: Your account does not moderate any site. If it should, ask the pilot team.
moderation.reasonField: Reason for the decision (the author sees it)

errors.unchanged: The content was already in that state.
errors.not_found: We could not find the content or you do not have permission.
errors.invalid: Check the reason: it is required and must be plain text of up to 500 characters.
errors.generic: We could not complete the action. Try again.

moderation.loadError: We could not load the report queue.

dossier.title: Dossier
dossier.hypothetical: Every intervention is hypothetical. None describes existing works or a municipal decision, unless the execution evidence says otherwise.
dossier.proposalNote: This is the exact published revision. Later private edits by its author do not change it.
dossier.proposalPreviewAria: Schematic preview of the dossier's proposal over the square boundary
dossier.comparisonLine: {added} interventions added against the baseline. Modeled shade: {shade} m² ({pct} %).
dossier.coverageNote: Shade covers only the inventoried elements; the square's survey is partial.

costLabels.fully_illustrative: Fully illustrative budget: evaluation prices, not supplier quotes.
costLabels.partially_illustrative: Partially illustrative budget: some prices are evaluation assumptions.

dossier.evidenceEmpty: No evidence has been recorded yet. A dossier cannot be marked as executed without it.
dossier.evidenceOpen: Open external link (opens in a new tab)
dossier.supportContext: {count} platform accounts support this proposal. It is context: it does not approve or change any status.
dossier.downloadsNote: Downloads follow the same access rules as this page.
dossier.promoteBody: Only the site's coordinators can do this. It creates a fixed dossier for this published revision.
dossier.promoteNoteHelp: Plain text, 1 to 1000 characters: why it is being promoted.
dossier.promoteAuthorized: This person or team authorized publishing their name
dossier.manageHidden: The publication is hidden by moderation. You can read the history but not record changes.
dossier.manageClosed: The dossier is closed. You can only verify evidence or correct the last status change.
dossier.responsibleName: Name of the person or team
dossier.responsibleHelp: Without authorization no name is stored. Do not write emails or phone numbers.
dossier.evidenceUrlHelp: Only the link is stored; the server never opens it. Its domain is shown.
dossier.evidenceVerify: Mark as verified by the team
dossier.transitionRules: Planning needs a public responsible and a milestone. Starting needs a note and evidence. Executing needs the observation, the difference, and new evidence. Discarding needs a reason.
dossier.revertBody: History is not edited: a correction event is added and stays visible in the timeline.
dossier.noEvidenceYet: Record evidence before citing it in a change.

saved.exists: A dossier already existed for this publication; the original is kept.

errors.plan_requires_responsible: To plan, a public responsible who authorized their name is required.
errors.plan_requires_milestone: To plan, at least one active milestone is required.
errors.start_requires_note: To start execution, write a progress note.
errors.start_requires_evidence: To start execution, cite at least one recorded evidence item.
errors.execute_requires_observation: To mark as executed, describe what was observed and the difference from the proposal.
errors.execute_requires_evidence: To mark as executed, cite new evidence, different from the evidence that supported the start.
errors.note_required: Write a note for this change.
errors.transition_not_allowed: That status change is not allowed from the current status.
errors.stale_state: Someone else changed the dossier before you. Reload the page.
errors.stale_milestone: The milestone changed before you. Reload the page.
errors.publication_hidden: The publication is hidden by moderation; changes cannot be recorded.
errors.invalid_evidence_url: The link must be a valid HTTPS address without a user name or password.
errors.invalid_evidence_reference: A cited evidence item does not belong to this dossier.
errors.evidence_date_in_future: The evidence date cannot be in the future.
errors.too_many_milestones: A dossier allows up to 20 milestones.
errors.too_many_evidence: A dossier allows up to 50 evidence items.
errors.event_limit_reached: The dossier reached its maximum of 500 events.
errors.milestone_transition_not_allowed: That milestone status change is not allowed.
errors.correction_not_allowed: There is no status change that can be corrected.
errors.not_found: We could not find the dossier or you do not have permission.
errors.generic: We could not complete the action. Try again.
